$comment: 听力训练营 L28（P-L3 续跑，阶段三第八课，委婉表达段）。脚本 100% 原创；Part 3 委婉表达（A restaurant is OK, but… / I'm not sure I can… / That's OK, but…；一段长对话 5 题：觉得去餐厅怎么样 / 对给十二个人做饭什么感受 / 觉得让大家带菜怎么样 / 对做蛋糕什么感受 / 觉得相册礼物怎么样）+ Part 5 匹配含「先选 A 后改 B」（Jack 告诉姐姐 Emily 五个亲友各带什么菜来奶奶的生日聚餐，8 种食物 A-H 全部被提到，3 个是干扰）。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: Grandma's Birthday Dinner
intro: 先听 Jack 和妈妈商量奶奶的生日聚餐：去餐厅还是在家？谁做饭？送什么礼物？说话人常用「is OK, but…」「I'm not sure」这样的委婉说法，真正的意思在后面，也要分清「别人说」和「我觉得」。再听 Jack 告诉姐姐 Emily 五个亲友各带什么菜——有人先说了一样后来又改了，要听「最后带的是什么」。8 种食物都会被提到，有 3 种没人带。

sections.intro: 听 Jack 和妈妈商量奶奶的生日聚餐。五道题问的是看法和感受，注意「is OK, but…」「I'm not sure」后面才是真正的意思，也要分清「别人说」和「我觉得」。

script.text: Jack, it's Grandma's birthday on Saturday, and twelve people are coming. Dad thinks we should go to a restaurant. He says he'll pay, and Grandma said last year that she'd like that.
A restaurant is OK, but Grandma says lots of things. She loves sitting in our kitchen with everyone talking at once. I think home is better. It's not about the money.
Maybe you're right. But I'm not sure I can cook for twelve. It's not the cooking, I love cooking. It's the time. I finish work at six on Saturday.
And our kitchen is tiny.
The kitchen's fine, we did Christmas dinner in it. Time is the problem. What if we ask everyone to bring something?
That's OK, but Aunt Sue always brings something, and her food is terrible. Remember her green soup? Nobody ate it.
We'll just ask her to bring bread. Grandma will love the idea. She did the same at her house last summer, so she won't think we're lazy.
Fine. And I'll make the birthday cake.
Are you worried about that? The last one was a little flat.
I'm not worried at all. I've made three now, and the last one was fine. I don't need any help. The candles are the problem. Grandma needs a lot of candles!
One big candle, then. And what about a present?
Emily and I want to make a big book of family photos. It only costs fifteen pounds to make.

I'm not sure. It's a lovely idea, and the price is fine, but Grandma's eyes aren't good now, and she already has hundreds of photos in boxes. A day out on the river boat would be better. She loves the river.
OK. A boat trip, then. I'll look at the times tonight.

questions.q: What does Jack think about having the dinner at a restaurant?
options: He thinks it costs too much.
He thinks Grandma would like a restaurant.
questions.explain: A restaurant is OK, but… I think home is better——「is OK, but」= 不想去餐厅。「贵」不对，he says it's not about the money；「奶奶想去餐厅」是奶奶去年说的，Jack 说 Grandma says lots of things。

questions.q: How does Mum feel about cooking for twelve people?
options: She doesn't enjoy cooking for so many.
She thinks the kitchen is too small.
She is worried about the time.
questions.explain: I'm not sure I can cook for twelve. It's not the cooking, I love cooking. It's the time——担心的是时间。「厨房小」是 Jack 说的，妈妈说 The kitchen's fine。

questions.q: What does Jack think about asking everyone to bring some food?
options: He thinks Grandma will like it.
He is worried about Aunt Sue's cooking.
He thinks it is a lazy idea.
questions.explain: That's OK, but Aunt Sue always brings something, and her food is terrible——担心 Sue 阿姨做的菜。「奶奶会喜欢」是妈妈说的；「懒」是妈妈说奶奶 won't think we're lazy。

questions.q: How does Jack feel about making the birthday cake?
options: He is worried it will go wrong.
He is happy to make it.
He wants Mum to help him.
questions.explain: I'm not worried at all. I've made three now… I don't need any help——他很有信心。「担心」是妈妈问的；「要帮忙」他说不需要。

questions.q: What does Mum think about the book of family photos?
questions.explain: I'm not sure… she already has hundreds of photos in boxes——「I'm not sure」= 不想要，理由是奶奶照片已经太多、眼睛也不好。「好主意」「价钱」只是客气话 It's a lovely idea, and the price is fine, but。

sections.intro: 听 Jack 告诉姐姐 Emily 五个亲友各带什么菜来奶奶的生日聚餐。把每个人和右边 A-H 的食物配起来。有人先说了一样后来又改了，要听「最后带的是什么」。8 种食物都会被提到，有 3 种没人带。

script.text: Jack, Mum said everyone's bringing food on Saturday. Do you know who's bringing what? I want to make a list.
Yes. Aunt Sue wanted to bring her soup again, the green one, but Mum said no very quickly. So Sue is bringing bread. She can't go wrong with bread.
Good. And Uncle Pete?
Pete said rice at first, but then he remembered that Grandma ate rice every day when she was a girl, and she's tired of it. So he's bringing chicken from that place on Hill Street.
The one with the yellow sign? Great. What about Leo?
Leo is making a big salad. He's got tomatoes and everything from his garden.
And Aunt Meg? She always brings something sweet.
Not this time, because I'm making the cake. Meg is bringing pasta, the one with cheese that Grandma likes.
And Rosa from next door? Is she coming?
She is, and she's bringing fish. She makes it with potatoes on top. Grandma asks for it every year.
Bread, chicken, salad, pasta, fish and your cake. Nobody will be hungry!

questions.explain: Aunt Sue wanted to bring her soup again… but Mum said no… So Sue is bringing bread——先说汤，后改成面包。
Pete said rice at first, but… So he's bringing chicken——先说米饭，后改成鸡肉。
Leo is making a big salad——直接说了，用自家花园的番茄。
Meg is bringing pasta——「甜的」这次不带，因为蛋糕是 Jack 做。
she's bringing fish. She makes it with potatoes on top——邻居带的是鱼。汤、米饭、蛋糕是干扰。
